sources.snippet: About Sana This paper presents SANA-Sprint, an efficient diffusion model for ultra-fast text-to-image (T2I) generation. SANA-Sprint is built on a pre-trained foundation model and augmented with hybrid distillation, dramatically reducing inference steps from 20 to 1-4.

sources.snippet: SANA is an efficiency-oriented codebase for high-resolution image and video generation, providing complete training and inference pipelines. This repository contains code for SANA, SANA-1.5, SANA-Sprint, SANA-Video, SANA-WM, SANA-Streaming, and Sol-RL. More details can be found in our 📚 documentation.
